cta: Need a location for your shoot?

sections.h2: The right house for the shot
sections.text:
Finding a location that looks right on camera, allows filming and is free on your date usually takes days of calls. Sourced. does that work for you. Tell us the look, the date and the size of your crew, and we come back with houses that fit, along with the cars, transport and security you need, in one quote.

Our current list covers stone and glass houses with indoor-outdoor pools, mansions with screening rooms and gardens, courtyard villas with indoor pools and bars, hillside houses with terraces and hot tubs, and gated family homes with cinemas and gyms, from Greater London out to Rickmansworth and Radlett. If what you need isn't listed, we find it.

cards.d: Large houses with pools, gardens, staircases and screening rooms for music videos, runway shows and fashion shoots.
Glass pavilions, stone and glass houses and modern builds with floor-to-ceiling windows and clean lines.
Indoor and outdoor pools, terraces and landscaped gardens for summer looks in any season.
Houses for launches, private events and crew stays, with parking for unit bases.
Raw spaces, infinity coves and green screen studios when the brief needs something industrial.
Listed or not, if it exists we can find it. Describe it in your brief.

sections.text: Send a brief with your shoot date, location area, crew size and the look you're after. You can add specific houses from our listings, or leave it open. We check availability and filming terms, then send one quote that covers the location and anything else you've asked for. Nothing is booked until you accept.

gallery.alt: Indoor pool location lit with neon

faqs.a: Mostly London and the Home Counties, including Greater London, Rickmansworth and Radlett. We can source further afield across the UK on request.

faqs.q: Can I book a location for one day?
faqs.a: Yes. Most shoots are booked by the day or half day. Tell us your hours and crew size and we'll price it.

faqs.q: Can you also sort cars, transport and security for the same shoot?
faqs.a: Yes. That's the point of Sourced. One brief covers the location, picture cars, crew transport, security and anything else, with one quote.

faqs.q: How quickly can you find a house?
faqs.a: Send the brief as early as you can. We'll tell you straight away what's realistic for your date.
